title: chore(deps): resolve @objectstack/* 17.6.0 in pnpm-lock.yaml and follow its mechanical contract moves; five owner-held reds reported by row (objectui#11438)
body:
Fixes #11438
Fixes #11227
Fixes #11094

## What this PR is

`pnpm-lock.yaml` now resolves `@objectstack/*` 17.6.0, regenerated with pnpm only and never edited by hand. Every gate that the bump turned red is listed below by row. The mechanical ones are done on this branch. The five that were not mechanical are each resolved on this branch under objectui#11438 ruling A″ (record 5968177777, confirmed by the maintainer: 「确认 A″，17.6 先落地」): row 4 is fixed, and rows 1, 2, 3 and 5 are booked to their owner cards with an expiry. See "Not mechanical" below. The branch head `0507d6716` is green.

| package | before (`main` lock) | after |
|---|---|---|
| `@objectstack/spec` · `types` · `core` · `client` · `formula` · `lint` · `sdui-parser` | 17.5.0 | 17.6.0 |

Nothing else moved. The resolution census compares package and snapshot keys between `origin/main`'s lock and this branch's lock in both directions: seven keys removed at 17.5.0 and seven added at 17.6.0, with no importer `specifier` line changed. The 17.6.0 packages ask for `zod ^4.6.5`, which the lock already resolves.

**How the lock was regenerated.** I used the 17.5.0 bump's route (objectui#11073). Every `@objectstack/*` specifier was raised to `^17.6.0` for one `pnpm install`. Every manifest was then restored byte for byte to HEAD, and a second `pnpm install` reconciled the importers back to their declared ranges. objectui#11509 (the jsdom 29.1 pin) landed on `main` while this was in flight. I merged `main` as a merge commit, not a rebase. git merged the lockfile without a conflict. Then `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` exited 0 with engine-strict on, a plain `pnpm install` left the lockfile byte-identical, and the census against the new `main` lock shows only the seven `@objectstack/*` moves.

## B3: lockfile-only, or must every floor move?

Lockfile-only, plus the floors the floor gates demand. On the bump alone they demanded none. objectui#11227's slice then made one floor rise: `@object-ui/types` raises its `@objectstack/spec` floor from `^17.5.0` to `^17.6.0` (`6b8a0ed96`, `.changeset/11227-types-spec-floor-17-6.md`), because its published types and zod mirror now read `EmptyState` / `EmptyStateSchema` from `@objectstack/spec/ui`, which 17.5.0 does not export. No other `package.json` range moves.

- `check:spec-floors` (`scripts/check-spec-range-floors.mjs`): its header says "A package's declared `@objectstack/spec` FLOOR must carry every symbol that package's own published artifact references". It judges symbol presence only. Over a full build it printed: "✅ Every consumer-facing @objectstack/spec floor carries the symbols its package's artifact references". With `--cross-check` it also printed "Dual-package cross-check: 54 entry point(s) — the `import` and `require` halves export the same names". Both exited 0.
- `check:installed-pin-claims` judges prose about the installed version, never a declared range. Its findings were 38 prose sites, handled below.
- No other rule here asks for floors to track the newest release. objectui#5793's ruling is "floors track reality", which the floor gate enforces. Every declared range already admits 17.6.0. On the bump alone, no package imported a 17.6.0-only export from published code; the one 17.6.0-only import (`@objectstack/spec/migrations`) is in a test file. `@object-ui/types` is now the exception above, and its floor rises with it.

## Disposition by row

### Done here (mechanical)

| gate / test | what 17.6.0 moved | done here |

| `check:spec-symbols` | `@objectstack/spec/ui` now exports `EmptyState`, the authoring type of a list view's empty-state config | ALLOW entry for `@object-ui/components:EmptyState`, which is a React component alias. That is the same disposition objectui#11073 gave the four `Object*Props` collisions. |
| `check:installed-pin-claims` | 38 sites named 17.5.0 | Each fact was re-measured on 17.6.0 with a 17.5.0 tarball as the control, then restamped. The retired-key spelling moved (see next row) and was reworded. Seven sites in four files that name a past release were added to the ledger as `historical`. Gate: `OK`. |
| retired-key pins (`retired-key-type.ts` and five pins) | the pinned spec's tombstone type is now the branded `[REMOVED]` mark, as on `main` | reworded: "the branded mark at the pinned 17.6.0 and on objectstack `main`, bare `undefined` through 17.5.0" |
| `writeWarningToast.test.ts` tripwire | `DroppedFieldsEventSchema.reason` lists `computed` | Did what the tripwire asked: the `\| 'computed'` widening is gone, the spent tripwire is deleted, and `_ReasonIsTheEnum` pins the exact four-member union |

The slotted-pages guide example drops `breadcrumb: true`, and the page-header doc now says the key is refused. |
| registry parity: dangling exemptions and ledger caps | `action:button` and `action:icon` no longer declare `endpoint` (objectstack `b3917d90`) | The two stale objectui#11111 bookings are struck. The cap goes from 3 to 1 and the owner total from 3 to 1; `undoable` is still owed to objectui#11168. |

| `grouping-field-padded-refused-7347` | `object-grid.grouping` is typed (it was `unknown`) | the bag member now refuses a padded name on every face, so it moves from the uncovered table to the declaring table; the node-level flat refusal stays uncovered |
| `nested-page-children-11223` | the spec's walk descends `page:card`'s `properties.footer[]` | The footer becomes a row of (a) and block (e) retires itself as it instructed. The CLI doc no longer names the footer as unjudged. ⚠️ Block (e) also asks that the closure be recorded on objectui#11223. That is a card write outside this dispatch's budget, so it is left to the seat. |
| `check:eager-closure` (Bundle Analysis) | the spec root sheds its migration chain: −250,096 gzipped eager bytes | The ceilings come down by exactly what was recovered (the second payback, objectstack#20646): aggregate 3,660,380 to 3,410,284, and `vendor-objectstack` 1,689,265 to 1,439,157. The baselines move to `2ba091c`. Two console builds were taken in one lock hold, with `main` `2d576e46` as the control; the table is in the file. Left unchanged, the gauge was blind (exit 2, headroom 3.01x). |

### Not mechanical: resolved by row under ruling A″

Each of these rows was owned by a card that waited on this bump while the bump could not land green without it. Ruling A′ (record 5965062249) made this branch the trunk: each owner's slice lands here as commits, reviewed at tier by its lane seat, with merge commits only. Ruling A″ (record 5968177777) lands the trunk on 17.6.0 as soon as it is green. A row that would ship a user-visible regression is fixed here. Any other row is booked to its owner card in objectui#11111 decision 3 = B's shape: a bounded ledger with the owner and an expiry, ⛔ never a skip, a deletion or a weakened assertion. Booked owner cards stay open.

1. **`object-grid` declares `description`, `emptyState`, `keyboardNavigation`** (objectstack `f5c7b2c7`, #20882). **Fixed for two keys, booked for one.**
   - objectui#11227's slice (`6a86dd13a`; contract record 5967010652 on objectui#11227): `GRID_QUERY_INPUTS` publishes `description` and `emptyState`, both renderers resolve `emptyState`'s I18nLabel members, and the four `object-grid-properties-bag-11276.test.ts` rows read 17.6.0. This PR completes objectui#11227.
   - `keyboardNavigation` is booked to objectui#11068 (`6c5011ded`, `bebd7ecdf`) in `registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts`. Its `unpublishedKeys` cap rises by exactly that entry, and the GA-block split row admits that one id by name. Expires 2026-11-02, or when objectui#11068's build lands.
2. **`record:line_items` gets its `ComponentPropsMap` row** (objectstack `24c554da`, #21142 / #21244). **Booked to objectui#11536** (`00c13e7`, `c9121f9`): ten unpublished keys and two unpinned members, with the caps moved by exactly those entries. Expires 2026-11-02, or when objectui#11536 lands.
3. **The dimensionless measure-arity check** (`checkDashboardWidgetDimensionlessMeasureArity`; objectstack `11d28c17`, #21053; objectui#8894 ruling D). **Booked to objectui#11334** (`0a518da48`, `c4775ed3a`) on the 7715 census row and as a bounded seven-type ledger in both objectui#8894 measure-door tests, each with a cap row.
   - On 17.6.0 the spec itself refuses a dimensionless multi-measure chart widget at save, so an author gets a loud refusal from the server, not a silent wrong answer.
   - The mirror waits for objectui#11334's own `Restart-when`: objectstack `main` renamed the export (`32d57690`), and the Spec Main Shape Gate refuses a static import of the 17.6.0 name. Expires when objectui resolves an `@objectstack/spec` that carries `32d57690`.
4. **`$empty` joins `FILTER_OPERATORS`, and `is_empty` / `is_not_empty` lower to it** (objectstack `f1e921ab`, #20446 / #20570). **Fixed** by objectui#11094's slice (`acd62a3a1` to `8a9cf1b5e`, merged as `9187c5c40`; contract record 5967059614 on objectui#11094). `ValueDataSource` executes `is_empty` / `is_not_empty` and `$empty`, and `convertFiltersToAST` lowers `$empty`. This was the one row that would have shipped a user-visible regression. This PR completes objectui#11094. objectui#10813 (the builders) lands on `main` afterwards as its own PR.
5. **`ActionSchema` gains `outcomeMessages`** (objectstack `d6d6e872`, #21214). **Booked to objectui#11344** (`13f07dd0f`) in `actionKeys.pin.test.ts`: the spec-inventory row requires `missing` to equal the one-entry ledger exactly, with `stale` still empty, and a new row asserts today's difference. Expires 2026-11-02, or when objectui#11344's slice lands.

⛔ None of these assertions was weakened, and no hold was touched.

No other test failed. `turbo run type-check` ran 81/81 tasks on the same head. On the lockfile-only commit `3796d59`, the bump-caused reds also included every mechanical row in the table above. ## Acceptance notes (observations, not filed)

- `packages/types/src/objectql.ts`, the `ObjectCalendarSchema.data` docblock: the sentence "`object-map` and `object-gantt` have no `ComponentPropsMap` row at all" was already false at 17.5.0. Both rows exist at 17.5.0 and at 17.6.0. I restamped only the measured line beside it.
- `retired-key-type.ts`: the bare-`undefined` arm now describes no installed spec, so it can be dropped. That tightens a helper every retirement pin reads, so I kept it here.
- `@object-ui/i18n` now namespaces a `picklists` group under `app`. Nothing in objectui reads `app.picklists` yet; that is the picklist feature's work (objectui#10202, held), not this bump's.
- `BASELINE.squashMerge` in `scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs` stays `null` and is owed a back-fill once this lands, the same as after objectui#11101.

## Deviation

The container runs Node 22.22.0. Before objectui#11509 reached this branch, the root `jsdom ^30.0.1` required `^22.22.2`, and `.npmrc`'s `engine-strict=true` refused every install. Until the merge, local installs ran with `--config.engine-strict=false`. That flag turns an engine refusal into a warning and does not change resolution: pnpm passes `engineStrict` only to the installability check, not to the resolver. After the merge, every install and gate above runs with engine-strict on.
